_sources: Competition slate + formats verified 2026-06 via convention.shpe.org/programs and shpe.org/events/programs/competitions, plus Penn State / UIC news (Academic Olympiad: teams of 3, written closed-book qualifier + Jeopardy-style oral, $3,000 to the winning chapter) and the Engineering Science Symposium page (oral + poster, 800-word abstract, cash prizes + $100 off registration). 'record' below = verified NATIONAL stakes (true regardless of chapter); BU's own placements/results are chapter records — fill from e-board archives.

tracks.name: Academic Olympiad
tracks.blurb: A two-day test of technical and SHPE knowledge: a written closed-book qualifier followed by Jeopardy-style oral rounds spanning math, the engineering disciplines, and SHPE history.

tracks.name: Extreme Engineering Challenge (XEC)
tracks.blurb: A non-stop 24-hour engineering sprint: teams move an idea through the full engineering process under milestone checkpoints, ending in a presentation to a board of judges.

tracks.name: Innovation Challenge: Engineering with a Purpose
tracks.blurb: Formerly the SHPE Hackathon — teams identify a need, build or improve a prototype, and pitch the solution, drawing on technical and business skills.

tracks.name: Engineering Science Symposium
tracks.blurb: A research showcase of oral and poster presentations across every engineering field. Submit an abstract; selected presenters defend their work to judges.
tracks.prize: Cash prizes per session + $100 off registration

tracks.name: Design Competition
tracks.blurb: Part of the Technology & Innovation Conference — a design challenge judged on engineering rigor, creativity, and presentation.

tracks.name: MAES Intern Tournament
tracks.blurb: A student-driven lecture series where recent interns present on their internships, study-abroad, and research experiences — celebrating pre-professional growth.

record.label: Academic Olympiad — prize to the winning chapter
National competition tracks open to BU
